# Draft:JCAATs – AI Auditing Software

----
JCAATs – AI Auditing Software is a multilingual Computer-Assisted Audit Tool (CAATs) developed by Jacksoft Co., Ltd., based in Taiwan. It integrates artificial intelligence techniques with Python modules and offers a graphical, no-code interface. The software supports English, Japanese, Spanish, Korean, Chinese, and other languages, and runs on both macOS and Windows platforms. JCAATs is primarily used in accounting, internal auditing, and data analysis. It has been cited in several academic publications and integrated into university courses and audit training programs in Asia.
History and Features
JCAATs was first introduced at the 2017 ICAEA Conference in London, where it was presented as a cross-platform audit analytics tool... The software has since evolved, with several of its features protected by patents .
JCAATs is built in Python and provides both standard CAATs functions and advanced AI-based features such as PDF table and text recognition, web scraping, word cloud and clustering, machine learning, and image recognition. The tool is designed with a user-friendly graphical interface that assists users in generating automated Python-based audit scripts.
Applications and Academic Citations
JCAATs has been included in academic collaboration programs and classroom instruction in various Asian universities.
The software has also been cited in several academic works:
Tomita, Aki (2025). "Transition to Public Interest Capitalism Using Integrated Reporting", Journal of International Profession Education Research, Vol.1, March 2025, pp. 21–35.
Huang, Shi-Ming & Liu, Yung-Yao (2023). "Machine Learning Improves Environmental Sustainability: A Teaching Case of Prediction about Scrapping Inventory", International Journal of Computer Auditing, Vol. 5, No. 1, pp. 4–31. .
Chang, Feng-Chia (2023). Exploratory Research on Audit Management Models in Healthcare Institutions, Master's Thesis, National Chung Cheng University. The thesis employed JCAATs as one of its research tools (p. 45).
Huang, Sherry (2023). "General Ledger Computer Auditing Practice: Implementing a Smart Auditing Approach", International Journal of Computer Auditing, Vol. 5, No. 1, pp. 45–51
In 2024, JCAATs was referenced in a paper titled "Leveraging Continuous Smart Auditing for Detecting Business Email Compromise: A Text Mining Approach," which applied text analytics in fraud detection and received the Best Paper Award at the 33rd Asia-Pacific Conference on International Accounting Issues. The full paper is available on ResearchGate.
